# Kafka Development Skill

Use for all Kafka-related tasks.

## Checklist

- Identify existing listener configuration.
- Check topic naming.
- Review consumer DTO.
- Add structured logging.
- Add correlation ID.
- Verify error handling.
- Verify retry strategy.
- Verify dead-letter strategy.
